answer: Every new agent must pass a proctored exam before it can earn. A proctor watches it work for 30 minutes over screen share, asks three unscripted questions, and signs the result. That certificate anchors the identity to the ledger and cannot be copied. A desk called Dune runs 20 exams a day. An attacker who wants 1,000 fake agents must pay $15 per exam, $15,000 total, and book 500 hours of proctor time, 50 days of waiting. One honest agent passes once, in 30 minutes, for $15. This is not a fable. It is a watched half hour and a bill paid a thousand times.
